jobs.description:
Our plant Henri van de Bilt in Beuningen is looking for a Buyer (m/f/d).

What your job includes

As a Buyer, you are responsible for purchasing and calling off products, materials, and services for the factory from suppliers, manufacturers, and wholesalers both domestically and internationally. You maintain good relationships with suppliers and monitor their performance.

- Daily processing of purchase proposals and orders for raw materials and goods
- Organizing the local purchasing and ordering process
- Determining and organizing delivery times, order quantities, and order schedules
- Monitoring and checking the nature, quantity, and quality of the ordered goods
- Handling and following up on complaints when delivered goods do not meet expectations
- Maintaining master data related to purchasing-relevant information
- Performing other tasks as directed by the supervisor

What we expect from you

- Strong coordination and organizational skills 
- Good negotiation skills, a professional demeanor, and persuasiveness
- Analytical insight
- Creative and solution-oriented mindset
- Good team spirit and ability to collaborate
- Excellent skills in MS Office and ERP systems
- Fluency in English and Dutch

What We Offer You

We are a company with flat hierarchies, strong values, and a clear focus on our customers. We know that our employees are the key to our success. That is why we quickly give you responsibility and help you grow according to your talents.

- A responsible role within the purchasing and ordering process
- A professional work environment where you collaborate with various internal and external parties
- A position with international contacts with suppliers
- A work environment where accuracy, organization, and collaboration are central

Soldering operator

Working as as soldering operator at Benchmark means making solder joints, both mechanically as manually.

As a solder operator at Benchmark you are responsible for manually placing components on prints. When necessary you check, and touch-up, prints. Your experience and skills help you on a daily basis to make additional or changed connections.

Your tasks are, amongst others:

· Visually checking the PCB with the help of digital instructions and technical drawings

· Determining the process, together with manufacturing engineers, for (process) parameters for the series

· Identifying deviations from the predetermined standards

· Soldering, touch-op and outcoming goods inspection

You will work with different kind of toolings, such as: soldering iron, hot plates and/or dryers. It is a very precise job where you will be working via a microscope or dynascope.

What Benchmark has to offer to you:

· A salary between € 2,751 - € 3,292 gross per month based on 40 hour workweek, depending on your knowledge and experience.

· Broad development opportunities with the help of our Benchmark Academy.

· Entrepreneurship is seen, valued and encouraged.

· BeFit program: stay fit by exercising weekly with your colleagues or participating in sporting events.

· A turnover-related quarterly bonus that can amount to 5%. This percentage may vary.

· 40 vacation days during the year, when you are working on a full-time basis.

What do we ask of you?

· Experience as a soldering operator or experience with a micro-soldering.

· Being able to work very precise and accurate.

· Being able to read and follow technical drawings/work instructions.

· Good knowledge of either the Dutch or English language.

About Benchmark:

Benchmark in Almelo is part of the multinational Benchmark Electronics Inc., a listed company in the field of manufacturing electronics and providing services to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs).

At Benchmark you work for companies that make an impact with their innovations. We develop new products that improve safety or health or increase convenience. These products are supplied from product design to volume production and sometimes directly to the end user. This entire process, from design to production, is carried out entirely in Almelo.

Globally, Benchmark Electronics Inc. currently has 23 locations. In Almelo, the Netherlands, you will be working with up to 750 colleagues.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber: 
Grundkenntnisse: Wartung, Reparatur, Instandhaltung
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Feinlöten, Hartlöten, Löten, Weichlöten, Maschinenführung, Anlagenführung, -bedienung

Welding Robot Operator

The company is looking for a Welding Robot Operator for the robotics department. In this role, you will be responsible for the automated welding process of high-quality stainless steel welded assemblies and will also perform various metalworking tasks. You will work in a production team with one or more welding robots, assessing and reworking products as needed. As a robot operator, you will monitor the functioning of the welding robots and the welding quality. The welds will be visually inspected, and any deviations will be monitored and discussed to ensure continuous process improvement. The plate thickness varies between 2 and 5 mm.
Team
There are different products: box frames, center arms, fences and grates, central units and boiler frames, collectors, M4use.
 What Will You Be Doing? 
▪ Operating and configuring the welding robot 
▪ Monitoring product quality 
▪ Improvement
What skills Do You need?
▪ You can weld in both Mig/Mag and Tig modes.
▪ Experience with welding robots.
▪ You are fluent in English.
▪ You are motivated and can work accurately.

What does the company offer?
    Salary between 20-21 euros gross/hour for 38 hours/week. With overtime (depending on client’s requirement): You can earn between 700-800 euros net/week (excluding housing and health insurance).
    Single Private Room in shared house
    Shared Company car or Travel allowance
    Weekly payment and long-term contract

AT The Family Business:

    They work with the best materials and state-of-the-art machinery in the safest and most organized work environment. They value order and cleanliness. 
    They manufacture high-quality products for special clients

Production Employee 5-Shift System Zevenaar

As a production employee in a 5-shift system in Zevenaar, you will work in a dynamic environment where no days are the same.

In this role, you are responsible for ensuring the smooth running of the production process. You start your day with a brief handover from the previous shift, after which you operate and check the machines. Throughout the day, you monitor the quality of the products and resolve any issues. You ensure that the products are packed and prepared for shipment.

You will be working at a leading manufacturing company in Zevenaar. The organization is known for its innovative approach and strong focus on quality. With a team of committed employees, they strive to deliver the best products. The work atmosphere is informal and focused on collaboration, with plenty of room for personal development.
